evidence_type: original native metadata-registration tables matched to original metadata field declarations; read-only offline parsing
limitations: Registration identity is established structurally and by independent field-offset matches, not by executing the registration call.
Static field offsets are relative to the owning class static-field storage; instance offsets are relative to the native object. These address bases must not be interchanged.
Raw table values for literals/thread-static/generic/value-type fields need their documented context; negative sentinel offsets are not ordinary field addresses.
Value-type instance offsets require the adjustment implemented in shipped LibCpp2IL.GetFieldOffsetFromIndex; the retained raw table rows are not silently adjusted.

registration.layout: 16 native-sized 64-bit fields on this PE32+ build; confirmed against shipped LibCpp2IL Read IL

candidate_search.pattern: Two aligned UInt64 count values equal to metadata typeDefinitionsCount, separated by one pointer (16 bytes)

rules.field_attributes: Il2CppType at registration.types[field.typeIndex]: native-sized Data at+0, UInt32 Bits at+8; Attrs=Bits&0xffff, typeEnum=(Bits>>16)&0xff. Static flag=0x10, Literal=0x40. Corroborated by shipped Il2CppType.Read and InitUnionAndFlags IL.
rules.type_sizes_layout: <IiII: instance_size uint32, native_size int32, static_fields_size uint32, thread_static_fields_size uint32
rules.vtable_encoded_entry: kind=raw>>29; decodedIndex=(raw&0x1fffffff)>>1 for v31; kind3 maps global method definition.

consumer_name_search.boundary: Only original Assembly-CSharp methods, metadata names; no native call graph inferred
consumer_name_search.limitation: AssetReferencer only declares Awake and ctor. No method named CreatePlayer or GetPool was found; candidate names are not proof of cache consumption.

iced_assetreferencer_consumer_candidates.evidence_type: Iced instruction decoding of candidate unwind ranges plus bounded straight-line register provenance; candidates require REA control-flow validation
limitations: Initial search only considers REX.W MOV/LEA RIP forms in PE sections marked executable.
Each candidate unwind range is linearly decoded from its declared begin; shared/chained unwind parents and actual metadata method extents need native analysis.
Register provenance tracks MOV copies and clears volatile registers at calls; it does not solve control-flow merges or aliasing.
The +0xb8 class static-field-storage interpretation comes from the parent native analysis; this scan preserves the actual instruction chain for review.
Nearest prior metadata method aliases are location candidates, not independent extent proof.
No runtime execution or object allocation was observed.
